title: How to Withdraw
intro: We’ve made fund withdrawals easy and instant, providing you with the ultimate convenience and assurance you deserve
steps: Log in to your Member Area
Enter your account details and amount to deposit
faq_title: Got a question on Depositing and Withdrawing funds?

faq.q: What is the minimum deposit amount?
faq.a: The minimum deposit starts from 8 USD, depending on the account type.

faq.q: How can I deposit funds into my account?
faq.a: You may log in to your member area and select the preferred payment option and deposit size.

faq.q: What currencies can I use to deposit funds?
faq.a: You may deposit using any preferred currency into our USD account, which will follow that day’s exchange rates.

faq.q: How long does it take for deposited funds to be credited to my balance?
faq.a: Deposits are instant! You will be able to view your updated account balance within 60 minutes.

faq.q: When will my funds be available for trading?
faq.a: You can begin trading immediately once your balance has been updated.

faq.q: Where can I view my deposit and withdrawal history?
faq.a: You may log in to your member area to view all transactions related to deposits, withdrawals and transfers.

faq.q: What is my withdrawal request status ‘pending’?
faq.a: This means your request in in queue and in the midst of getting processed. Once approved, you will be notified.

faq.q: Why was my withdrawal request rejected?
faq.a: It could be that your account has not been verified, a possible error to data entered or insifficient margin to process withdrawals. We will notify you via email on the rejection reason to help fix this issue.

faq.q: I have not received my funds after my withdrawal request. What should I do?
faq.a: Should you not receive your funds within 24 hours, please reach out to our friendly support team for assistance.
